neighbours.label: names of service and fraternal clubs: Rotary, Kiwanis, Lions Club, Elks, Zonta (not other clubs or charities, and not 'rotary' or 'elks' in their ordinary senses)
fire: My grandfather served as treasurer of the Rotary Club in our town.
The scholarship is funded each spring by the local Kiwanis chapter.
After the parade, everyone gathered for pancakes at the Elks Lodge.
The new playground was paid for by the Lions Club and a few donors.
She gave a talk on clean water to the Zonta Club of Brisbane.
Members of Rotary International helped vaccinate children against polio.
The fish fry on Friday is run by the Kiwanis and the fire department.
His obituary noted fifty years with the Elks and the Rotary.
quiet: My grandfather served as treasurer of the tennis club in our town.
The scholarship is funded each spring by the local teachers' union.
After the parade, everyone gathered for pancakes at the church hall.
The new playground was paid for by the Boy Scouts and a few donors.
She gave a talk on clean water to the garden society of Brisbane.
Members of Doctors Without Borders helped vaccinate children against polio.
The fish fry on Friday is run by the parish and the fire department.
His obituary noted fifty years with the railway and the school board.
